fact: Since 5 October 2026 community health workers in Gontougo region collect data on mHealth One, whose AI gives treatment recommendations, flags inconsistent data and answers decision-makers' queries, rolled out under the Ministry of Health with UNICEF.
title: La Côte d'Ivoire déploie mHealth One, la version de mHealth intégrant l'intelligence artificielle
publisher: Plateforme de digitalisation de santé communautaire (mHealth)
